annotations.title: How rare a special chart combination (yoga) really is

description: Says how common or rare a particular combination in a birth chart (a yoga) really is, e.g. Gaja Kesari, Dharma-Karma Adhipati, Hamsa, Malavya, Budhaditya, Kemadruma, Kaal Sarp, Neecha Bhanga Raja yoga. Useful when someone has been told their chart has a special, lucky or worrying yoga and wants perspective: "is X yoga rare", "how rare is my yoga", "Gaja Kesari kitna rare hai", "pandit ji ne Kaal Sarp dosh bataya, kitna common hai". Accepts English, Hindi or Hinglish names ("yog" works too); no birth data needed. Returns "found in about 1 in N charts", the percentage, a rarity label (common / uncommon / rare / very rare), a one-line meaning and a Learn link, from AstroCalc's Monte-Carlo sample of 5,000 Indian birth charts run through its yoga engine. A bare "Kaal Sarp" counts all 12 types together.

lang.description: Language of the text fields: 'en' (English, default) or 'hi' (Hindi).
